name: Paste
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For Paste, store a local encrypted clipboard history with search, pinboards, and expiration. The hard boundary is apple-platform polish, icloud sync, rich previews, and universal capture, plus os integration polish and maintenance.
